gaps.message: Positions are the parties' own words: manifestos, policy documents, official statements and leaders' statements, each with its date. Some are years old or reached through a news report quoting the party. 'No stated position found' means we looked and found none, not that the party has no view.
Foreign policy, constitutional rights and immigration are national matters, not decided by city councils. They're shown because they matter to voters.

economy.summary: Ring-fence and reinvest water and electricity revenue, use public-private partnerships for infrastructure, let municipalities buy/sell power, cost-reflective tariffs.

manifesto.title: Getting South Africa Working for All: Local Government Manifesto 2026

housing_land.quote: Releasing unutilised state-owned land parcels for housing developments.
housing_land.summary: Release unused state land for affordable, medium-density housing; deliver title deeds; overhaul housing allocation for transparency.

human_rights.quote: If the issues identified in the Bill are not addressed during the legislative process, this Bill will have a chilling effect on freedom of speech.
human_rights.summary: Opposed the Hate Crimes and Hate Speech Bill as drafted, saying it would chill freedom of speech.

immigration.quote: make it easy for investors, tourists, and skilled individuals to enter legally, and hard for illegal immigration and abuse
immigration.summary: Backs the Home Affairs White Paper: first-safe-country asylum rule, points-based skilled immigration, tougher enforcement against illegal immigration.

israel_palestine.quote: a two-state solution that results in the creation of a sovereign and unoccupied Palestine co-existing in peace next to a secure Israel
israel_palestine.summary: Supports a negotiated two-state solution with a sovereign Palestine beside a secure Israel; rejected Netanyahu's opposition to Palestinian statehood.

lgbtq.quote: protecting the rights of all people, particularly vulnerable and minority groups like the LGBTQI+ community
lgbtq.summary: Called on government to show commitment to protecting LGBTQI+ people, including from homophobic attacks on visitors.

policing.quote: We will make communities safer by bringing policing closer to the people.
policing.summary: Wants policing powers, budget and investigative powers devolved to capable municipalities, plus more technology and partnerships.

priorities.text: End cadre deployment; appoint municipal staff on merit to build corruption-free, professional administrations.
Reinvest water revenue into water infrastructure, fix leaks, and use private-sector investment and expertise.
Reinvest electricity revenue into grids and let municipalities buy and sell their own power.
Bring policing closer to residents by devolving policing powers and budget to capable municipalities.
Restore neglected public spaces and waste collection, partnering with communities and the private sector.
Grow jobs by cutting red tape, supporting informal traders, releasing land and delivering title deeds.

economy.summary: Keep tariffs fair and reduce reliance on above-inflation increases; protect free basic services; use DBSA and PPPs where appropriate.

manifesto.title: ANC 2026 Local Government Manifesto: A Better Life for All - Let Us Continue Building Better Communities, Together

housing_land.quote: facilitating title deed transfers and supporting affordable and social housing
housing_land.summary: Upgrade informal settlements, expand serviced sites, facilitate title deeds and social housing, reverse apartheid spatial patterns.

human_rights.quote: This is an extremely important piece of legislation and one which will further strengthen acceptance of diversity in our country.
human_rights.summary: Welcomed the Hate Crimes and Hate Speech Act as strengthening acceptance of diversity.

immigration.quote: Government-subsidised housing will be allocated to qualifying South Africans in accordance with the law, while trading spaces and permits are properly regulated.
immigration.summary: Enforce immigration and labour laws with Home Affairs; subsidised housing for qualifying South Africans; regulate trading permits.

israel_palestine.quote: The ICJ’s ruling on provisional measures is a significant victory for humanity and the Palestinian cause.
israel_palestine.summary: Celebrated the ICJ provisional measures in the genocide case against Israel; supports a free Palestine and a two-state solution.

lgbtq.quote: Protect older persons, persons with disabilities, LGBTQI+ and other vulnerable residents by ensuring municipal facilities, public spaces and pedestrian routes are safe and accessible
lgbtq.summary: Manifesto names hate crimes against LGBTQI+ people as a safety threat and commits to protecting LGBTQI+ residents.

policing.quote: Policing remains primarily the responsibility of SAPS, but local government has a real role to play
policing.summary: SAPS leads policing; municipalities strengthen by-law/metro enforcement, lighting and Community Safety Forums with SAPS and CPFs.

priorities.text: Reliable, quality and affordable basic services and infrastructure, including roads, water and human settlements.
Economic development and jobs, prioritising South African workers and businesses in municipal opportunities.
Safe, clean, healthy and resilient communities through Community Safety Forums and stronger by-law enforcement.
Sustainable municipal finances: billing audits, fair tariffs, automatic indigent registration for grant recipients.
Capable developmental local government with zero tolerance for corruption.
Community participation, with councillors reporting regularly to residents against measurable targets.

economy.summary: Insourcing over outsourcing, progressive tariffs, larger free basic services, expropriation of abandoned land and no sale of municipal land.

manifesto.title: EFF Local Government Elections Manifesto 2026 (Victory or Death!)

housing_land.quote: Use its expropriation powers to expropriate abandoned land and buildings in order to make these available for use by young people for agriculture and other business activities.
housing_land.summary: Use municipal expropriation powers on abandoned land and buildings; redistribute municipal land to black communities instead of selling it.

human_rights.searched: 2026 manifesto (no civil-liberties section); effonline.org blocks access; news search on EFF free expression/rule of law found only reporting, no checkable quote.

immigration.quote: We reject xenophobia in all its forms and have consistently maintained that the failures of the South African state cannot be blamed on poor African migrants seeking survival
immigration.summary: Rejects xenophobia; blames state failure, not African migrants; denies door-to-door campaigns against foreign nationals.

israel_palestine.quote: We further commend the declaration of the Israeli diplomat and call for the president to adhere to the long-standing resolution of parliament to close the Israeli embassy with immediate effect
israel_palestine.summary: Calls for immediate closure of the Israeli embassy per Parliament's 2023 resolution; strongly backs the ICJ case.

lgbtq.quote: Protect the rights and dignity of vulnerable groups, including children, senior citizens, LGBTQIA+ persons, and sex workers, through inclusive municipal services and programmes.
lgbtq.summary: Manifesto commits to protect the rights and dignity of LGBTQIA+ persons and sex workers through inclusive municipal services.

policing.quote: Work with the South African Police Service and other stakeholders to develop integrated crime prevention strategies based on identified crime hotspots.
policing.summary: Strengthen municipal law enforcement staffing and training; develop hotspot-based crime prevention with SAPS.

priorities.text: Municipalities acquire land for residential, commercial and agricultural use; stop selling municipal land.
Insource security, cleaning, waste collection and maintenance to create permanent municipal jobs.
Increase free basic water and electricity allocations and introduce progressive tariff structures.
Fight crime and corruption with stronger municipal law enforcement and hotspot-based strategies with SAPS.
Gender equality, safety and social programmes, including protection for vulnerable groups.

economy.summary: Rejects privatisation and user-pays for basic services; indigent protection, flat fee for working poor, wealthy and big business pay more; land value capture.

manifesto.title: The People's Mandate: 2026 Local Government Election

housing_land.quote: Radical economic transformation means changing who owns the land and who receives municipal contracts.
housing_land.summary: Change land ownership and contract beneficiaries; upgrade informal settlements in place; release well-located public land.

human_rights.quote: MK municipalities will restore public order and rebuild shared spaces without compromising the rule of law or human dignity.
human_rights.summary: Manifesto says restoring public order must not compromise the rule of law or human dignity; calls basic services human rights.

immigration.quote: MKP municipalities will enforce immigration and employment laws, act against employers who exploit undocumented workers, and reserve designated service-industry opportunities for South African citizens.
immigration.summary: Enforce immigration and employment laws, act against employers of undocumented workers, reserve some service jobs for citizens.

israel_palestine.quote: the MK Party stands in solidarity with the people of Lebanon and Palestine, who have long suffered under the brutal policies of Israeli expansionism
israel_palestine.summary: Stands with Palestinians and Lebanese against what it calls Israeli expansionism; calls for ceasefire and pressure on Israel.

lgbtq.quote: Who made the law that a man can date another man? Who will women be left with?
lgbtq.summary: Party leader Jacob Zuma criticised the legal recognition of same-sex relationships at an MK rally.

policing.quote: strengthen municipal policing, traffic enforcement and by-law enforcement.
policing.summary: Strengthen municipal policing, traffic and by-law enforcement; cooperate with SAPS against cable theft and construction disruption.

priorities.text: Bind MK municipalities to a People's Contract with 100-day, 1,000-day and five-year targets.
Keep water and electricity under public control; reject privatisation and the user-pay principle for basic services.
Jobs, localisation and African ownership through municipal procurement and investment zones (PIIRZs).
Spatial justice: upgrade informal settlements first and release well-located land for mixed-income housing.
Safe, clean communities: streetlights, municipal policing, by-law enforcement and immigration law enforcement.
A Fair Fiscal Contract: protected indigent services, flat fee for working poor, firm collection from those able to pay.

economy.summary: Cut red tape and fund small businesses; reform local government funding to match responsibilities; merit-based financial management.

manifesto.title: Local Government Elections Manifesto 2026: Partner With Us to Build Stronger Municipalities - We Work For You

housing_land.quote: IFP municipalities will identify suitable land and improve municipal planning to continue rolling out housing programmes, to address housing backlogs, support the redevelopment of hostels
housing_land.summary: Identify land for housing programmes, redevelop hostels and formalise informal settlements.

human_rights.quote: racism at all levels must be tackled with vigour to rid our society of all the remnants of the evil apartheid system.
human_rights.summary: IFP KwaZulu-Natal said Human Rights Day should focus on service delivery and eradicating racism.

immigration.quote: The IFP believes that the spaza-shop industry must be reserved for South Africans in every municipality
immigration.summary: Says illegal migration strains services; reserve spaza sector for South Africans; prosecute fronting for undocumented foreign nationals.

israel_palestine.quote: remains steadfast in our belief that a Two-State solution for Israel and Palestine could provide the peace, justice, and stability that the Middle East so desperately needs.
israel_palestine.summary: Advocates non-violence, negotiation and a two-state solution; urged all parties to lay down arms.

lgbtq.searched: 2026 manifesto (no mention); ifp.org.za newsroom; news searches for IFP LGBTQI/Pride/hate-crime statements.

policing.quote: IFP municipalities will maintain municipal electricity distribution infrastructure and repair streetlights and high-mast lighting to improve safety and support economic activity.
policing.summary: Links crime to failed streetlights and weak by-law enforcement; commits to repairing streetlights and high-mast lighting.

priorities.text: Trust us for jobs: local employment, spaza shops reserved for South Africans, protected livelihoods.
Deliver basic services and working infrastructure, with maintenance before crisis and trackable fault reporting.
Protect traditional and Khoi-San institutions, including constitutional amendments clarifying their powers.
End corruption and make every rand count through merit appointments and financial discipline.
Empower women, youth and persons with disabilities through bursaries, skills and GBV-focused budgets.

economy.summary: The rich should bear the brunt of tax; grants for disabled, very poor and elderly; state bank to compete with private banks (2024 national manifesto).

manifesto.election: 2024 national (a 2026 local manifesto exists per press reports but no primary copy was found)
manifesto.title: Turnaround Strategy 2024 (national election manifesto)

housing_land.quote: The PA will reinstitute finance policies that worked in the past, such as the thirty-three-and-a-third subsidy scheme
housing_land.summary: Revive past housing-finance subsidies such as the one-third subsidy scheme for people banks will not finance.

human_rights.quote: Human rights should not mean that citizenship rights and responsibilities are completely ignored.
human_rights.summary: Manifesto argues human rights claims of illegal migrants should not override citizens' rights.

immigration.quote: South Africa faces a migration crisis and illegal migrants must be mass deported.
immigration.summary: Mass deportation of illegal migrants, detention camps, audits of foreigners' papers and penalties for employers.

israel_palestine.quote: We have never taken a side, except to push for a genuine two-state solution, which would bring the violence to an end.
israel_palestine.summary: National spokesperson said the PA backs a two-state solution, condemns Hamas and also supports a free Palestine.

lgbtq.quote: the LGBTQIA+ community is us, they are part of the PA
lgbtq.summary: Leader formed an LGBTQIA+ league in the party and said members who do not accept LGBTQIA+ people must go.

policing.quote: A PA government will reintroduce the death penalty in severe cases of murder where guilt has been proven beyond any reasonable doubt.
policing.summary: Bring back the death penalty for certain murders; specialised police units, forensic investment and rape courts.

priorities.text: Place God first and reintroduce religious principles in education.
Zero tolerance for illegal immigration: mass deportation, detention, and a border wall.
Compulsory military or public service for youths not in education or employment.
Return of the death penalty for severe, proven murder cases.
Elevate royal and local leaders so communities benefit from mining on their land.
Return to a capable state, cutting reliance on consultants and private contractors.

economy.summary: Cap rates and tariff increases at inflation, ring-fence rates to wards, protect property rights, drop BEE-based contracting, favour private-sector growth.

manifesto.title: VF Plus Municipal Elections Manifesto 2026 (It is our time / Green will get it done)

housing_land.quote: PROTECT PROPERTY RIGHTS AND RESPECT PROPERTY OWNERS' LAWFUL INTERESTS.
housing_land.summary: Protect property rights and property values; orderly urban expansion; address unfair rates on agricultural land.

human_rights.quote: Establish proper and accountable governments based on Christian values; and usher in a dispensation where all groups and communities enjoy equal rights.
human_rights.summary: Calls for governments based on Christian values and a dispensation of equal rights for all groups and communities.

immigration.searched: 2026 manifesto (no immigration section); news and site searches for FF Plus immigration statements (only a minister's prisons repatriation remark, not a party statement).

israel_palestine.quote: The FF Plus reiterates its support for the state of Israel, and recognises Israel’s right to defend itself and its civilians by all means necessary.
israel_palestine.summary: Condemned Hamas's 7 October attack, supports Israel's right to self-defence; later called SA's ICJ case a political stunt.

lgbtq.searched: 2026 manifesto (no mention); news searches for FF Plus statements on LGBTQ/same-sex/gender identity.

policing.quote: It is essential to consistently police and enforce municipal by-laws.
policing.summary: Consistent by-law enforcement after review; coordinate police, CPFs, neighbourhood watches, rural safety and private security; CCTV and streetlights.

priorities.text: Devolve decision-making and power to communities over taxes, services, safety and heritage.
Reinvest a substantial share of each ward's rates and levies in that ward.
Fair rates and taxes: no tariff hikes above inflation, uniform tariffs, smart meters, accurate bills.
Repair infrastructure: spend grants fully and at least 8% of asset book value on maintenance.
Merit-only appointments regardless of skin colour or political affiliation; more engineers and tradesmen.
Govern on Christian values and act as a stable, principled coalition partner.

economy.summary: Limit rates and tariff increases to inflation unless justified; those who can pay must pay; insource where practical and affordable.

manifesto.title: Let's Fix South Africa: ActionSA 2026 Local Government Election Manifesto

housing_land.quote: Where land is safe and suitable, we will support progressive in-situ upgrading and improve basic services while longer-term development continues.
housing_land.summary: In-situ informal settlement upgrades, site-and-service and affordable housing, act on hijacked buildings, faster title deeds.

human_rights.quote: Restoring order must never mean criminalising poverty.
human_rights.summary: Manifesto says by-law enforcement must be fair and must not criminalise poverty; vulnerable residents treated with dignity.

immigration.quote: We will use every lawful municipal power available to us and work closely with the Department of Home Affairs, SAPS and other responsible authorities
immigration.summary: Immigration is a national competence, but municipalities should use all lawful powers and refer violations to Home Affairs and SAPS.

israel_palestine.quote: ActionSA’s policy on this and other global conflicts is grounded in a shared sense of global humanity and a responsibility to protect the vulnerable
israel_palestine.summary: Called for de-escalation and protection of civilians on all sides; no stated position on the ICJ case found.

lgbtq.quote: ActionSA came out in full support of the South African LGBTQI+ community and their right to equality as part of an inclusive society.
lgbtq.summary: Party president declared unconditional support for LGBTQI+ equality, saying it does not undermine family values.

policing.quote: We will progressively increase municipal law-enforcement capacity according to population, local enforcement needs and what each municipality can sustainably afford.
policing.summary: Grow and train municipal law enforcement, specialised units for infrastructure theft and drugs, stronger municipal courts.

priorities.text: Fix what matters most: reliable water, electricity, roads, refuse removal and infrastructure.
Respect residents' money: financial discipline and rates/tariff increases capped at inflation unless justified.
Professional, merit-based municipalities that insource where it makes sense.
Safe communities under the rule of law: more law enforcement, by-law enforcement, action on illegal immigration.
Help businesses flourish by cutting red tape and attracting investment.
Leave no community behind: expand services, housing and transport progressively.

economy.summary: Unbundle municipal tenders, set-aside procurement quotas, local labour targets, insourcing, pensioner utility rebates and expanded free basic allocations.

manifesto.title: Al Jama-ah's National Manifesto 2026 (12 key priorities)

housing_land.quote: Fast-track title deed issuance with published quarterly targets and public digital tracking.
housing_land.summary: Fast-track title deeds with public tracking; formal tenure and serviced stands for informal settlement residents.

human_rights.quote: Protecting the Right to be free from mass surveillance.
human_rights.summary: Describes itself as promoting a human rights-centred society, including freedom from mass surveillance and torture.

immigration.searched: 2026 manifesto page (no mention); aljama.co.za; news search (only a journalist's characterisation of the Joburg candidate's stance, no direct quote).

israel_palestine.quote: Do not vote for any zionist affiliated parties or parties toning down for votes whilst a genocide rages on and directly impacts on the people of Cape Town.
israel_palestine.summary: Calls Gaza a genocide, stands in solidarity with Palestine, urges voters to reject 'zionist affiliated' parties.

lgbtq.quote: Al Jama-ah calls on government to dismiss any proposals by LGBTQI+ community from being included in the revised White Paper on Family Life
lgbtq.summary: Urged government to exclude LGBTQI+ proposals from the family White Paper; opposed LGBTQI+ content in schools.

policing.quote: strengthen municipal law enforcement within its legal mandate; work with SAPS, Community Policing Forums, Neighbourhood Watch Committees, Schools and Community organisations
policing.summary: Prevention-led safety: lighting, municipal law enforcement within mandate, partnerships with SAPS, CPFs and neighbourhood watches.

priorities.text: Sewer, water and road recovery with ward-based rapid repair teams and smart meters.
Unbundle tenders for local contractors; 30% procurement for women, youth and persons with disabilities.
Insource EPWP workers into permanent ward-based maintenance, waste and security teams.
Fast-track title deeds and move informal settlement residents to formal tenure and serviced stands.
Integrate minibus taxis, BRT, buses and rail into unified transit networks.
Zero tolerance for corruption: councillor scorecards, livestreamed bid adjudication, public contract dashboards.

economy.summary: Rates that consider income, higher relief thresholds, rental fairness compact, insourcing and local worker-focused procurement.

manifesto.title: The GOOD Way Forward: Cape Town plan (summary); separate Western Cape towns manifesto

housing_land.quote: Build City-owned, rent-stabilised flats on public land
housing_land.summary: End spatial apartheid; use public land for City-owned rent-stabilised flats; make land release produce affordable housing.

human_rights.quote: Our courts have repeatedly affirmed the right of immigrants to emergency healthcare, recognising that denying this right would breach South Africa’s international human rights commitments
human_rights.summary: Welcomed a ruling that Operation Dudula's clinic blockades were unlawful, citing constitutional and international human rights obligations.

immigration.quote: We have consistently condemned the blocking of hospitals and clinics by members of Operation Dudula as not in line with our Constitution or our legal framework.
immigration.summary: Condemns xenophobic vigilantism such as clinic blockades; says immigrants are not to blame for the health system's state.

israel_palestine.quote: welcome attempt to deliver justice to Palestinian civilians who are being unjustly collectively punished for Hamas’ attack on Israel on 7 October 2023
israel_palestine.summary: Supported South Africa's ICJ case; later challenged MPs who visited Israel over Gaza famine and genocide findings.

lgbtq.quote: We recognise that LGBTQIA+ rights are integral to the broader fight for social justice and equality
lgbtq.summary: Says LGBTQIA+ rights are human rights and part of social justice; had an LGBTQIA+ rights policy in its founding manifesto.

policing.quote: Professionalise & demilitarise law enforcement - trained, community-centred, rights-driven.
policing.summary: Says more boots on the ground won't solve violent crime; wants demilitarised, community-centred law enforcement and social investment.

priorities.text: An affordable city: income-sensitive rates, higher rates-relief threshold, protect prepaid electricity, free off-peak transport.
A working city: insource cleaning, security and maintenance; support cooperatives and small traders.
An equitable city: one service standard for every community, ending the 'tale of two cities'.
A housed city: end spatial apartheid; build City-owned, rent-stabilised flats on public land.
A trusted city: real powers for sub-councils, ward participatory budgeting, open bid committees.
A safer city: demilitarised, rights-driven law enforcement, GBV focus, investment in youth and public spaces.

housing_land.quote: The city evicts NGOs, people that try to start libraries from the council flats. We're saying we're going to reverse that thing
housing_land.summary: Leader says an NCC-led Cape Town would reverse evictions of NGOs and community projects from council flats.

human_rights.quote: the descendants of the indigenous peoples to take up our rightful place as equal citizens of South Africa
human_rights.summary: Leader framed equal citizenship and dignity for descendants of indigenous peoples as the party's core demand.

immigration.searched: News searches for NCC/Fadiel Adams immigration statements.

israel_palestine.searched: News and Parliament searches for Fadiel Adams/NCC on Israel, Palestine or Gaza.

lgbtq.searched: Party portal site; news searches for NCC/Fadiel Adams LGBTQ statements.

policing.searched: Briefly (27 Oct 2026) reports Adams on drug outlets and crime prevention, but only in paraphrase; no direct quote on policing.

economy.summary: Fair rates and tariffs linked to local conditions and service actually delivered; protect indigent households; cut waste before raising charges.

housing_land.quote: Release of well-located land for integrated human settlements where possible.
housing_land.summary: Corruption-free allocation, release well-located land, upgrade informal settlements, act against building hijacking, tenure security.

human_rights.quote: municipalities must engage them constructively while upholding constitutional democracy, the rule of law, and the rights of all residents.
human_rights.summary: Manifesto commits to constitutional democracy, rule of law and rights of all residents, including in dealings with traditional leaders.

immigration.quote: We stand with South Africans who are calling for the lawful enforcement of our immigration laws
immigration.summary: Deputy president told Parliament the UDM backs lawful enforcement of immigration laws, framing it as economic not racial.

israel_palestine.quote: The UDM believes and supports a Palestinian statehood.
israel_palestine.summary: Welcomed the ICJ Rafah order; supports Palestinian statehood and a negotiated settlement involving all parties.

lgbtq.quote: Your existence is not up for debate. Your right to live free from fear is non-negotiable.
lgbtq.summary: Condemned anti-LGBTQIA+ remarks by Ngizwe Mchunu as hate speech; a UDM member laid an SAHRC complaint.

policing.quote: The South African Police Service (SAPS) carries the primary policing mandate, but municipalities cannot wash their hands of community safety.
policing.summary: SAPS leads, but municipalities must act: by-law enforcement, municipal policing capacity, lighting, CCTV, support for CPFs.

priorities.text: Reliable basic services with maintenance at the centre: fix existing infrastructure before new projects.
Clean governance: merit appointments, action on Auditor-General findings, whistle-blower protection.
Fair tariffs linked to ability to pay and service levels, with credible indigent registers.
Local economic development favouring South African-owned small businesses, cooperatives and informal traders.
Fair housing allocation, well-located land release, informal settlement upgrades, action against hijacked buildings.
Written, publicly disclosed coalition agreements tied to service delivery outcomes.

economy.summary: Ring-fence water and electricity revenue, PPPs and private investment, reasonable tariff benchmarks, oppose expropriation without compensation.

manifesto.title: ACDP Manifesto 2026 Local Government Elections: Vote for the South Africa You Deserve

housing_land.quote: Oppose the expropriation of land without compensation and advance land reform and development
housing_land.summary: Opposes expropriation without compensation; supports title deeds, land audits, serviced stands, preventing land invasions.

human_rights.quote: This is in conflict with the right to freedom of religion (section 15) and the right of freedom of association (section 18) afforded by the Constitution.
human_rights.summary: Opposes state vetting or licensing of churches as a breach of freedom of religion and association.

immigration.quote: While condemning all forms violence against undocumented foreigners, ensure that authorities strictly enforce existing immigration laws, humanely execute lawful deportations
immigration.summary: Secure borders; strictly enforce immigration law with humane deportations while condemning violence against undocumented foreigners.

israel_palestine.quote: Regrettably, by now taking sides by lodging this court case with the ICJ, it can no longer play a role as an honest peace-broker
israel_palestine.summary: Opposed the ICJ case, saying SA took sides and lost its role as peace-broker; doubted genocidal intent could be proven.

lgbtq.quote: the ACDP will not change their position on same sex marriage
lgbtq.summary: Opposes same-sex marriage on biblical grounds; leader says an ACDP government would serve and not segregate against anyone.

policing.quote: Devolve policing down to the lowest level depending on the capacity of that level
policing.summary: Raise SAPS and metro police budgets, devolve policing, more visibility, roadblocks and stop-and-search, close drug dens.

priorities.text: Merit-based, accountable municipal management; prosecute and personally recover losses from corrupt officials.
Reliable, affordable energy, including clean coal baseload and more competition and renewables.
Boost small businesses and township economies; cut red tape; even-handed enforcement of trading by-laws.
Housing: title deeds, release state land, eradicate informal settlements with permanent housing.
Community safety: more police funding, devolved policing, roadblocks, prevent land invasions.
Partner with churches and faith-based organisations in health and social services.

economy.summary: Fund commitments from ring-fenced service revenue, reprioritised budgets, PPPs and grants; no new debt; rates rebates for small businesses.

housing_land.quote: Releasing well-located, under-utilised state and municipal land and buildings for social and affordable housing developments, located close to transport and economic hubs.
housing_land.summary: 90-day municipal land audit, release land for social/affordable housing, clear title-deed backlogs, regulate short-term rentals.

human_rights.quote: Where service delivery is arbitrary, delayed, or politically discretionary, it degrades dignity in the same manner as the violation of human rights.
human_rights.summary: Frames fair, predictable service delivery as a matter of dignity comparable to human rights protection.

immigration.quote: Anyone wishing to live, work, or operate a business in South Africa must be fully documented and legally registered.
immigration.summary: Zero tolerance for unlawful economic participation; municipal levy for foreign nationals; licensing priority for SA-owned businesses.

israel_palestine.quote: Protracting the battle instead of resolving it is a misstep by the ANC government
israel_palestine.summary: Called the ICJ case a misstep; urged a peaceful resolution and a two-state solution instead.

policing.quote: Bringing policing closer to communities through empowered, accountable Metro Police services working hand in hand with residents.

priorities.text: Service delivery: water, electricity, sanitation and housing administered fairly and on time.
Jobs and local growth using procurement, licensing, land and public employment, putting South Africans first.
Safety: empowered, accountable Metro Police working with residents; body-worn cameras.

manifesto.title: SACP 2026 Local Election Manifesto (published in Umsebenzi Online)

housing_land.quote: the state must have the power to acquire it, including through expropriation in the public interest
housing_land.summary: Stop selling well-located public land to private owners; redistribute land; state power to expropriate in public interest.

human_rights.quote: These policies threaten to replace those rights an services with an increased role for monopoly capital

immigration.quote: warning against xenophobic attempts to blame foreign nationals for South Africa's social crisis
immigration.summary: Central Committee warned against xenophobic attempts to blame foreign nationals for South Africa's social crisis.

israel_palestine.quote: the SACP reiterates its call for the international isolation of apartheid Israel and the prosecution of all those individuals involved in perpetrating the genocide
israel_palestine.summary: Calls Israel an apartheid state committing genocide; wants its international isolation, prosecutions and BDS.

lgbtq.searched: 2026 manifesto/Umsebenzi edition (no mention); sacp.org.za and news searches for SACP LGBTQI statements.

policing.quote: We need functioning public services, accountable policing, organised communities, youth development, safe public spaces and effective action against criminal syndicates
policing.summary: Safety requires accountable policing, organised communities, youth development and action against syndicates and extortion.

The right to decent work through public employment, cooperatives and municipal public enterprises.
Land, homes and food for social need: release public land; expropriation in the public interest.
Safe, caring and healthy communities with accountable policing and organised communities.

Councillors who seek mandates and report back; ward assemblies and participatory budgeting.
